And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul. See Gill on .
And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer. See Gill on .

The God of my rock; in him will I:trust: he is my shield,

and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour;

thou savest me from violence. See Gill on .
I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies. See Gill on .
When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. See Gill on .
The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me. See Gill on .

In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God:

and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears. See Gill on .
Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth. See Gill on .
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. See Gill on .
He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet. See Gill on .
And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind. See Gill on .

And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters,

and thick clouds of the skies. See Gill on .
Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled. See Gill on .
The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice. See Gill on .
And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them. See Gill on .
And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils. See Gill on .
He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters. See Gill on .
He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me. See Gill on .
They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay. See Gill on .

He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me,

because he delighted in me. See Gill on .
The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me. See Gill on .
For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God. See Gill on .
For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them. See Gill on .
I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity. See Gill on .
Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. See Gill on .
With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt show thyself upright. See Gill on .
With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt show thyself unsavoury. See Gill on .
And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down. See Gill on .
For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness. See Gill on .
For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. See Gill on .
As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him. See Gill on .
For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God? See Gill on .
God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect. See Gill on .
He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places. See Gill on .
He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. See Gill on .
Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great. See Gill on .
Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. See Gill on .
I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them. See Gill on .
And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet. See Gill on .
For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me. See Gill on .
Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me. See Gill on .
They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not. See Gill on .
Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad. See Gill on .

Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people,

thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me. See Gill on .
Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. See Gill on .
Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places. See Gill on .
The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation. See Gill on .
It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me. See Gill on .
And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. See Gill on .
Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name. See Gill on .
He is the tower of salvation for his king: and showeth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore. See Gill on .
